notes.title: QuietMansion2 Ver4.01 is now available!
notes.content:
[b]This update fixes the following defects[/b]
・Fixed a bug that an error occurs when using a controller.
・Fixed a bug that some UI cannot be selected when using a controller.
・Fixed a bug that enemies do not fall down.
[b]This update adds the following elements[/b]
・Added the ability to change image quality from within the game.
・Added the ability to change resolution from within the game.
・Added the ability to change settings with the controller.
・Adjustment of HDR
・A test function to maximize the depiction of shadows and make them look more realistic was implemented in the early stages of the game.

[b]A demo version of the new game is now available![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1670400

notes.title: Ver3.04(Users Voice Update) has been delivered!
notes.content:
[b]This update fixes the following issues[/b]
・Fixed a bug where you couldn't hear the sound because it was overlapping
・Change the title logo
・Corrections to the UI
・Review the picture quality settings
・Fixed a brightness
・Significant correction of image quality level
・Correct the image quality of shadows
・Fixed a bug that prevented you from changing the volume in some cases
・The Sentence of the settings has been greatly modified
・Correction of difficulty
・Significantly improved the performance of the game
・Fixed a bug that caused an error in some scripts
・Improved operability of the language selection screen and ending UI
[b]This update adds the following elements[/b]
・Support for high quality anti-aliasing
・Support for high quality post-effects
・Compatible with 144Hz monitor
・release the texture limiter on game objects
・HDR support
・Support for high frame animation
・Support for audio noise reduction function
・Additional direction
・Added a function to skip the beginning of the scene
・Added the ability to donate to developers

notes.title: About serious bugs in trial version
notes.content:
A fatal bug is currently discovered in KENGOHAZARD 2 Demo
However, some demo game files were lost
Suspend trial distribution as recovery takes time
Everyone, please wait for a while

[b]Currently known bugs[/b]
・ KGS does not work properly
・ If you turn around in a narrow place, it penetrates the stage
・ Enemy AI does not work

thank you for your cooperation.
